narrative.overview:
Every surface is a sheet of paper-like stock in one of three flat colours (blue field, cream, ink), torn from the previous sheet along a perforated edge. The one recurring object is the seat: an arched-top tab that appears as the diary slot, legend key, slider thumb, list bullet, FAQ chevron and comparison glyph. Buttons are ticket stubs with bitten sides; rules between rows are dotted like tear lines. Nothing is shadowed.

The voice is plain and dry, and the interface is dense with small facts set in a geometric-grotesque display face over a warm serif reading face. Pink is scarce on purpose: it is the colour of a seat that is available right now.
keyCharacteristics: Three section themes swapped by a class, each setting its own background, text, rule and focus colours.
Arched "seat" silhouette reused for every small control and marker.
Perforation (half-circle bites, dotted rules) as the structural joint between sections and rows.
Flat, no shadows; state is shown by fill change and a 2px lift.
Mobile rotates the seating plan: time runs down, rooms become columns.

rules.name: The Open Seat Rule
rules.body: Pink means a seat is open, offered or refilled, plus its pulse ring, the time-axis beat marker, and the focus ring on dark surfaces. Buttons, links, headings and decorative accents are cream or ink, never pink.

rules.name: The Sheet Theme Rule
rules.body: A section picks one of the three themes (t-field, t-cream, t-ink) and everything inside reads its variables. Do not hard-code colours inside a section. Adjacent sections use different themes.

rules.name: The Cream Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus ring is 3px solid, offset 3px: pink on field and ink, ink on cream.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Interface text (labels, buttons, numbers, names, dt) is the grotesque; running prose and table cells are the serif.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any time, length or price uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate layers with colour change, a perforation or a dotted rule, never with a shadow.

dos: Do reserve seat pink for open, offered and refilled seats, the pulse ring, the time-axis beat marker and the focus ring on dark surfaces.
Do build buttons and UI accents from cream and ink.
Do reuse the arched seat silhouette for any new small control or marker.
Do join sections with a perforated edge and rows with dotted rules.
Do pair every colour state with text or shape (dashed, flag, "Check:" prefix).
donts: Don't use pink for buttons, links, headings or decoration.
Don't add shadows; use colour and edge instead.
Don't hard-code colours inside a section; use the theme variables.
Don't set prose in the grotesque or UI labels in the serif.
Don't present any figure, name or quote as real; all content is labelled illustrative or fictional.
